profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | 12+ Years Mobile | Android (Kotlin) Architecture & iOS (Swift, Objective-C) | GenAI-Driven Planning | Leading 12+ Engineers
profile.summary:
Results-oriented Senior Software Engineer with over 12 years of experience designing and delivering innovative mobile solutions for global leaders like Walmart, The Home Depot, and Sam's Club, as well as emerging tech startups. I specialize in transforming fresh ideas into high-performance mobile applications that serve 10M+ users daily, driving digital transformation and enhancing user engagement through agile methodologies and user-centric design.

Most recently, I've expanded from Android-focused engineering into cross-platform technical leadership — owning solution architecture, implementation planning, and delivery alignment across both iOS and Android for a 12+ engineer team. I'm hands-on in iOS as well, building new features in Swift while maintaining the existing Objective-C codebase. I write architecture and solution documents, partner with Product/Delivery Management (PDM) on quarterly mobile feature roadmaps, and lead a GenAI-driven prompt engineering initiative for spec planning — helping developers land on the right architecture before a single line of code is written, which cuts down on rework and speeds up delivery. I also build cross-platform training programs that bring Android and iOS developers up to speed on upcoming feature work.

My expertise spans end-to-end software engineering, architectural design, and performance optimization, with a proven track record of leading cross-functional teams to exceed market expectations. Passionate about leveraging emerging technologies like Jetpack Compose and CI/CD pipelines to solve complex challenges, I bridge technical and non-technical audiences to align strategy with business goals.

Let's connect to explore how I can contribute to your next big project!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead architecture and cross-platform technical direction for iOS and Android, guiding a 12+ engineer team and partnering with PDM on quarterly mobile feature delivery.

Define and document solution architecture for new features, producing implementation and design docs used to align engineering, product, and delivery management on scope and timelines
Architect using MVVM with Clean Architecture, Repository pattern, and Dependency Injection (Dagger/Hilt/Koin) across iOS and Android, with Jetpack Compose on the Android side
Working hands-on in iOS — shipping new features in Swift while maintaining and extending the existing Objective-C codebase
Lead a GenAI-driven prompt engineering initiative for spec planning on Jira stories, helping developers identify the right architecture upfront and surface issues before development starts — reducing rework and shortening delivery cycles
Provide architecture-level decision-making across a 12+ engineer team spanning iOS and Android, using Jira and Confluence for sprint planning and documentation
Lead push notification system improvements, working across the stack to strengthen reliability and delivery
Drive integration of Quantum Metric (QM) for in-app performance monitoring and user experience analytics, with GitHub/GitLab-based CI/CD pipelines and Firebase for backend services
Built and delivered cross-platform training for Android and iOS developers to prepare teams for upcoming feature work and keep engineering practices consistent across platforms
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership Management · Technical Leadership · Building Leadership Teams · Software Infrastructure · Small Team Management

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed high-traffic Android features for the Walmart mobile app, serving millions of daily users. Built performance-optimized solutions and complex UI designs using MVVMC architecture, Custom Rendering, and Kotlin. Used monitoring tools like Splunk, Quantum Metric, and Open Observer to pinpoint performance issues and ensure app stability at scale. Led technical discovery efforts, contributed to architectural decisions, and established best practices for code quality and accessibility.

Key Achievements:

Optimized Walmart Cash Page: Reduced load time from 4.5s to 3s, on the most-visited page in the Catalog
Delivered Offers Feature: Enabled customers to view unlimited manufacturer offers on a single page with category filter, removing the previous 20-item limit
Built User Reviews System: Created a comprehensive review system on the Item Page where users can write reviews, react with likes/dislikes, and flag inappropriate content
Redesigned Membership Management: Simplified the pause and cancellation flow for Plus Members, leading to better retention
Launched Q&A Feature: Enabled real-time question resolution, helping customers make confident purchase decisions and reducing support inquiries by 15%
positions.insights: Skills: Quantum Metrics · Open Observer | Splunk · Feature Flagging · A/B Testing · Application Scaling · Performance Diagnostics · User Engagement Metrics · Accessibility Compliance

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contributed to the digital transformation of Home Depot's mobile app, enhancing both in-store and online shopping experiences. Built responsive, user-friendly interfaces with robust backend integrations. Led initiatives to improve app functionality with a focus on scalability and code quality through comprehensive testing. 

Key Projects & Achievements:

Developed features for THD Pro Customers: Built the In-Store View experience, improving satisfaction for professional contractors and business customers 
Enhanced Product Discovery: Worked on Product Listing Pages (PLP) and Product Detail Pages (PDP) to streamline the shopping experience 
Implemented Buy Online, Pick-up In-Store (BOPIS): Developed the customer buy belt feature, enabling seamless online-to-store purchases 
Created Bulk Buying Capabilities: Built functionality for Pro users to purchase products in bulk 
Launched Special Promotions: Developed Special Buys of the Day and Week features to highlight time-sensitive deals 
Improved Onboarding Experience: Designed and implemented customer onboarding flows for new app users 
Collaborated with Product Teams: Refined user stories to improve clarity and ensure features were developer-ready and testable 
Strengthened App Reliability: Developed custom testing scripts to validate application performance and resiliency in production environments 
Followed Best Practices: Configured and set up programs using Home Depot-approved methodologies on large-scale projects
positions.insights: Skills: E-commerce App Development · GraphQL · Adaptive UI Design · Push Notification Systems · Mobile-First Product Strategy · Modular Codebases · Multi-Threaded Processing

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Led technical development of the Backroom Reinvention App at Sam's Club, an MVP designed to streamline warehouse operations including inventory tracking, purchase order processing, and claims management. Managed the complete project lifecycle from requirements gathering and application design to implementation, delivering the solution within tight timelines. 

Key Achievements: 

Enabled Mobile Workflows: Successfully migrated the entire Claims & Receiving application to Android devices, allowing associates to work from anywhere using handheld devices and complete processes smoothly on the go 
Built Hardware Integration: Integrated Camera API and Zebra Scanner on TC70 devices to capture printer MAC addresses, UPC barcodes, and images, improving operational efficiency and data accuracy 
Delivered BYOD Solution: Empowered Sam's Club employees with a user-friendly Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) experience, increasing flexibility and productivity 
Improved App Performance: Used Fabric and Microsoft App Center to monitor application performance, identify issues, and implement fixes, resulting in a more stable and crash-free experience 
Met Aggressive Timeline: Delivered a fully functional MVP within limited time constraints, establishing a solid foundation for future enhancements
positions.insights: Skills: Enterprise Mobility Solutions · Inventory Management · Logistics Workflow Automation · Warehouse Operations Software

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
Developed the Franciscan Alliance app to boost employee engagement across healthcare facilities through location-based services, event notifications, and interactive social features. Managed the complete software development lifecycle using Android SDK and Gradle, incorporating Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) for real-time interactions and Firebase for backend services. 

Key Features & Achievements: 

Built Employee Engagement Platform: Created a comprehensive solution for Franciscan Alliance healthcare employees to participate in polls, share patient recovery stories through video uploads, and foster a positive workplace environment across facilities 
Implemented Competitive Features: Developed leaderboard functionality to track participation by individual facilities and overall across the alliance, encouraging healthy competition and engagement 
Integrated Estimote Beacons: Implemented Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) technology to deliver location-based notifications when employees passed by specific areas, enhancing real-time communication 
Enabled Content Sharing: Built video upload capabilities allowing staff to share patient recovery stories and success moments, promoting a supportive and uplifting atmosphere 
Established Seamless Communication: Integrated RESTful APIs for smooth data exchange between the app and server, ensuring reliable communication and data handling 
Collaborated with Stakeholders: Worked closely with Franciscan Alliance representatives to incorporate feedback and ensure the app met the specific needs of healthcare employees
positions.insights: Skills: IoT Connectivity · Personalized User Journeys · Mobile Application Development · Hospitality Industry · User Engagement Metrics

company.name: Resolute Digital, a Weber Shandwick Company

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description: Developed the Android app for UrbanRestro (now BookEventz), enabling users to browse venue listings, submit inquiries, and complete reservations through CCAvenue payment gateway integration. Built RESTful APIs with multithreaded HTTP calls to improve performance and ensure smooth data exchange using JSON. Integrated Facebook and Twitter SDKs to enhance user engagement and implemented push notifications to deliver timely updates. Collaborated with the product team to define and document specific product requirements and established best practices for application architecture.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed the Jano Duniya news app with live video streaming capabilities for the news channel, delivering breaking news alerts and comprehensive Hindi news coverage across multiple categories including sports, entertainment, politics, public safety, and current affairs.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Developed E-ONE ERP, an in-house Enterprise Resource Planning system with integrated modules for accounts, order processing, inventory management, manufacturing, and job costing. Built Contact Relationship Management capabilities within the same application, ensuring seamless integration across all components. Designed industry-specific modules with consistent integration standards to meet diverse business needs.

honors.title: Experience Team of the Year - Backroom Reinvention
honors.description: Recognized as part of the Experience Team of the Year for leading the Backroom Reinvention initiative at Sam's Club. Delivered an MVP mobile solution that transformed warehouse operations by migrating Claims & Receiving processes to Android devices, enabling associates to work efficiently from anywhere using handheld devices. The project streamlined inventory tracking, purchase order processing, and claims management while meeting aggressive timelines and establishing a foundation for future digital transformation across Sam's Club facilities.

honors.title: 1st Runner Up - Google Hackathon
honors.description: Awarded 1st Runner Up for developing a healthcare app that provides symptom analysis, cause identification, and remedy recommendations. Integrated Augmented Reality to help users locate nearby hospitals in real-time, demonstrating innovation in making healthcare information and services more accessible.
honors.issuer: Issued by Google Developer Group(New Delhi)

projects.title: LPL Financial
projects.description: Migrated a legacy Java application to Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, improving performance and UI responsiveness. Built modular, reusable code and designed custom UI components including Switches, Date Pickers, Dropdowns, and ViewComponents to streamline development and maintain design consistency.

projects.title: Main Event (Dave & Buster’s)
projects.description: Redesigned the Main Event mobile app using Kotlin, improving event reservations, loyalty rewards, and in-app purchases for better usability and operational efficiency. Enhanced backend integrations with Firebase and dependency injection frameworks to support scalable architecture and improve app reliability.
